# NORTHBANK — BUSINESS ACCOUNT
### Product document for campaign use
**Status:** Current as of this quarter. Figures below are the only figures approved for external copy.

---

## WHAT IT IS

A business current account for sole traders and companies with fewer than ten staff. Opened online, with no branch visit and no appointment. Money is held with a partner bank and protected by the FSCS up to £85,000.

## WHO IT IS FOR

Owners who run the business and the books at the same time — trades, studios, consultancies, small shops. The account is built for a person doing their own reconciliation on a Sunday evening, not for a finance department.

## THE FIGURES

- Monthly account fee: none.
- Interest paid on balances: 2.75% AER, on balances up to £85,000.
- Time to open an account, from first form to working card: about 8 minutes.
- Businesses banking with Northbank: more than 14,000.
- Transfers between Northbank accounts: free, with no limit on how many.
- Currency conversion: charged at 1%, with no fee added on top.
- Minimum balance: none. No charge for an account left empty.
- Support hours: 7 a.m. to 9 p.m., seven days a week.
- Median wait for a human on support: under 3 minutes.
- Trading since 2019.

## WHAT THE ACCOUNT DOES

Invoices are raised from the same screen the money lands in. Receipts are attached to the transaction they belong to by photographing them. Categories are set once and applied afterwards without being asked again. At the end of the year the whole ledger exports to a spreadsheet or to the customer's accountant directly.

## WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

No lending. No overdraft. No cash deposits over the counter — cash goes in at the Post Office, and takes two working days to clear.

## WHAT CUSTOMERS SAY THEY NOTICED FIRST

That nothing had to be scheduled. That the card arrived before the welcome email. That a question asked at 8 p.m. on a Saturday was answered by somebody who could see the account.

## COMPETITIVE CONTEXT

High-street business accounts typically charge a monthly fee after an introductory period and require an appointment to open. Two of the three largest charge for transfers between their own accounts.

## LEGAL

"Northbank" is a trading name. Northbank is not a bank; deposits are held with a partner bank and protected by the FSCS up to £85,000. AER is variable. Nothing in campaign copy may describe the account as offering credit, an overdraft, or a guaranteed rate.
